'''Xenozoology''' was the study of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] wildlife. [[Mola Haxtor]] and [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Sadus Vraal]] were [[xenozoologist]]s, and an [[Institute of Xenozoology]] existed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
